title: Android TableLayout wrap-content columns
purpose: Check that changing a wrap-content cell label resizes the shared column in both table rows.
changes: TableLayout now uses each supported child's current measured width for shared-column sizing and gravity placement.
steps: Find the two rows under Wrap-content shared columns: Short and One occupy the first column, Next and Two the second. The second-column cells should line up.
Tap Change table label. Short becomes Longer label and the first column widens; Next and Two should both move and remain aligned. Tap again to restore Short.
Enable Right-to-left layout and repeat. Column order should mirror and both rows remain aligned. Choose OK if it works, or Reject with the failing step, what you saw and your device.
expected: The shared column follows the longer label without overlapping, and both rows stay aligned in LTR and RTL.
limits: This covers Bhoo's supported TableLayout measurement. Complete Android text, theme and table parity are not verified.
validation: Six Rust TableLayout tests passed, including dynamic shared-column width, row alignment and RTL.
Full libbhoo Rust test suite passed.
A 320 × 500 browser test verified changing width, both-row alignment and RTL placement.
